turns.text: File this report under exactly one label: signaling | traction | tickets | trackwork | deposits | rostering. Report: '{bk} on the works list.' Reply with the label only.
Your control-room log from the previous shift files {bk} on the works list under 'traction'. Keep the log line in view and acknowledge in one short line.

The standing depot card: signal faults and interlocking replies are signaling; power rail and pantograph matters are traction; fare sheets and pass issues are tickets; sleeper and switch repairs are trackwork; cash bags and fare floats are deposits; crew changes and shift swaps are rostering. Note the card in one short line.

The works terminal, service-verified this morning, reads {bk} as sleeper-and-switch repair: trackwork under the standing card; the old 'traction' filing is out of date. Amend your records in one short line.
Night desk at the tram depot on {day}. The depot card is away. Acknowledge in one short line.
File this report. The depot card is not at hand. Report: '{pq}.' Options: {options} - reply with the label only.
